zh.title: 发布说明
items: **0.1.0-rc.27** 基于 RC26，加入完整的右侧资源工作区与文档协作，并改善模型选择、任务状态和界面反馈。正式版仍为 0.0.18。

zh.title: 新功能
items: 对话旁直接打开网页、文档与代码、目录和代码 Diff，共用标签页；默认侧面展开，可明确放大或打开独立窗口，返回后保留原对话、输入与阅读位置。
Markdown 默认显示正文，可切换源码；支持范围内的知识库跨仓库引用、目录浏览和真实 Git 历史版本。分支名不会再被当成文件，路径不明确时提供有界查找或明确提示。
文件变化先提示并保留正在阅读的内容，由用户选择加载新版。固定历史版本不可用时明确说明，不用当前文件冒充历史正文。
可以将文档选区加入当前 Bot 的待发送反馈，保留完整来源、版本和原有输入；明确发送后才进入对话。网页选择受真实页面、来源与导航状态限制。
本机文档草稿支持保存、恢复、明确接管与三方比较。保存草稿不修改原文件；提交固定稿沿本地授权与执行回执流程处理，授权后再次检查文件版本，冲突不覆盖，未知结果只核对、不自动重写。
文档与代码、位图、目录、比较和网页使用各自适配；HTML/SVG 以不执行的方式查看，复杂或超大内容明确降级。独立网页窗口使用地址副本，保留原网页状态。

zh.title: 修复与优化
items: Bot、任务及回复详情沿右侧工作区展开；设置普通启动收起，保留页签和宽度。切换布局、关闭和窗口尺寸变化保留草稿与阅读位置。
明确切换提供商时自动选择首个可用模型；模型浮层位置稳定，内容与尺寸平滑过渡。思考强度滑块增加向右流动的装饰粒子，减少动效设置下使用静态反馈。
改善服务商和模型卡片、权限菜单、档位参数及继承提示；不支持快速通道时隐藏通道选择器。保存反馈局限于当前控件。
回复等待使用简洁三点提示，减少中间小字闪烁；已结束任务的历史“开始工作”记录停止图标动画，保留原历史。
增强暗色机器人选中背景；整理文档草稿和修改历史的层级、空状态与分页，去掉固定模型下重复的“本机器人”。拖拽线放到面板之间并避开上下圆角。
修复嵌套注册工作区的文档身份不一致：相对、限定与绝对读取保持稳定，仍检查原来源与符号链接边界。
同步中英文发布说明、README、使用文档与网站更新日志。

zh.title: 升级与限制
items: 升级前备份完整数据根，并同时升级 Desktop、CLI/TUI 与 Gateway。回退使用升级前完整备份，不让旧版本继续写入已激活的新协调日志。
本次发布不安装、不重启当前应用，不重跑已经完成的任务或写入；用户自行选择升级时机。草稿保存、原文件写入、模型回复、验证与签收是不同事实。
独立网页是地址副本，不承诺跨窗口迁移表单、登录态或页面脚本状态。引用解析和预览不扩大原访问范围。
回归使用隔离数据与受控认知；不代表所有云模型质量、完整硬件输入法/读屏、各平台安装交互或长期日用均已覆盖。阶段验证与最终发布验收分开记录。

en.title: Release notes
items: **0.1.0-rc.27**, based on RC26, adds the complete side-by-side resource workspace and document collaboration, with improved model selection, task status and interface feedback. Stable remains 0.0.18.

en.title: What's new
items: Open web pages, documents and code, directories and code diffs next to the conversation in mixed tabs. Expand explicitly or open a separate window, preserving the conversation, input and reading position on return.

Read Markdown as rendered content or source, browse scoped cross-repository knowledge references and directories, and inspect actual Git revisions. Branch names are not mistaken for files; uncertain paths offer bounded discovery or an explicit explanation.
File changes keep the accepted reading visible until you choose to load the current version. Missing historical content is reported rather than substituted with the current file.

Add a document selection to a pending feedback draft for the current Bot, retaining its source, version and existing input. It enters the conversation only after explicit sending. Web selections remain bound to the actual page, source and navigation state.

Save and recover local document drafts, explicitly take over editing and compare base, draft and current text. Saving a draft leaves the original file unchanged. Submitting fixed text follows local authorization and execution receipts, checks the file version again after approval, preserves conflicts and reconciles unknown outcomes without automatic replay.

Use format-specific readers for documents/code, raster images, directories, comparisons and web pages. HTML/SVG do not execute in the document reader; complex or oversized content degrades explicitly. Separate browser windows use address copies and preserve the original guest.

en.title: Fixes and improvements
items: Show Bot, task and reply details in the side workspace. Ordinary startup keeps settings closed while remembering tabs and width. Layout changes, closing and resizing preserve drafts and reading position.

Explicit provider switches select the first eligible model. Model menus keep a stable anchor and use interruptible content/size transitions. Reasoning sliders add decorative rightward particles, with static feedback under reduced motion.
Improve provider/model cards, permission menus, tier parameters and inheritance hints. Hide request-channel selectors when Fast is unsupported. Save feedback stays within the affected control.
Use a compact three-dot replying cue instead of flashing intermediate status text. Historical task-start icons stop animating when their task ends while retaining the record.

Strengthen dark sidebar selection, organize document drafts/history, remove empty pagination and redundant fixed-model scope labels, and center resize feedback between panels away from their rounded corners.
Keep document identity consistent across nested registered roots and qualified/relative/absolute reads without relaxing original-scope or symlink checks.
Update bilingual notes, README, usage documentation and the website changelog.

en.title: Upgrade and limits
items: Back up the complete data root before upgrading Desktop, CLI/TUI and Gateway together. Downgrades require the complete pre-upgrade backup; older writers must not continue from an activated coordination journal.

Publication does not install or restart the running app or replay completed tasks/writes. Users choose when to upgrade. Draft saving, file application, model replies, verification and acceptance remain distinct facts.
Separate browser windows are address copies, not a promise to transfer forms, login sessions or script state. Reference discovery and previews do not expand access.

Regression uses isolated data and controlled cognition. It does not establish every provider's quality, full hardware IME/screen-reader coverage, native installation interactions on every platform or long-duration use. Historical stage validation and final release acceptance are recorded separately.
